title: A constant multiple of a general-ratio geometric series is Cauchy
statement: CReal.geomScaledCauchyOfLt: for 0<=x<1 and any CReal scale c, sumRange (fun n => c * x^n) is Cauchy -- geomCauchyOfLt's series scaled by a constant factor, built via cauchyOfPointwiseEquiv from converges_mul acting on the unscaled geometric Cauchy sequence.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.geomScaledCauchyOfLt : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal.le CReal.zero x0) -> ((x2 : CReal.lt x0 CReal.one) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : CReal.PosBound (CReal.add CReal.one (CReal.neg x0)) x3) -> ((x5 : CReal) -> CReal.Cauchy (CReal.sumRange (fun (x6 : AxNat) => CReal.mul x5 ((fun (x7 : AxNat) => CReal.pow x0 x7) x6)))))))))
